# BotBeaver

> BotBeaver builds and maintains AI chat agents plus growth services (marketing, SEO, AEO, and more) so US businesses answer leads and show up where buyers search.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://botbeaver.ai/): AI lead capture and growth for US service businesses
- [How it works](https://botbeaver.ai/process): Implementation and go-live process
- [Services](https://botbeaver.ai/services): AI SDR, marketing, SEO, AEO, and related services
- [FAQ](https://botbeaver.ai/faq): Buyer questions on chat, go-live, and outbound rules
- [Contact](https://botbeaver.ai/contact): Lead capture and meeting request
- [Book a meeting](https://cal.com/abdul-rehman/30min): 30-minute Cal.com consultation

## Services highlights

- AI Sales Development Representative (website chat)
- SEO, AEO, GEO, AIO
- Web and mobile development
- CRM, funnels, ads and social
